messages.subject: Re #5467: Suspended linked-actor bounded design D0-D7 (design only, susveh HOLD)
messages.body:
Re #5467: bounded linked-actor DESIGN PROPOSAL for Suspended. Design only: no code, no facts, no integration, susveh stays HOLD. Based on your sealed audit (suspended-linked-actor-retained-audit.txt), my packet #5461, and the #5466 addendum. I accept your corrections: groupneg DOES call 25030(152) on the already-established path with no store; the call tuple's 3rd item is the next-return PC; the observer PC is not the exact store opcode. Separately, the canonical store sites are 25091/25094/25113/25120.

D0 SCOPE. This is a new, separate role: "linked actor" = the executable's current command-target robot. It is NOT the player identity. resolvePlayer, playerObject/playerGlobal and the primary-player semantics stay unchanged. No Suspended playerGlobal fact. All existing wearable/on/moved/concealed facts and guards stay byte-for-byte; no new semantic bit is inferred from role evidence.

D1 FACT SHAPE (proposed and not yet authorized; a digest-pinned executableLayoutFacts entry for 6011284a... only):
  linkedActor: { selectorGlobal: 130 /*G114 WINNER*/, roomGlobal: 212 /*G196 WINNER-HERE*/, actorDomain: [<exact singular robot ids>], groupSentinels: [142 /*TWOBOTS*/], deadGlobal: 63? /*G47 DEADBOTS, slot to verify*/, roomsRoot: 189 }
  actorDomain is an explicit, verified id list. It is never derived from names, spelling, the last addressed noun, opcode scores or guesses. Known so far: Poet 146, Sensa 152 (and Iris 158 seen as the G0 boot value). The full 6-robot list is a validation gap, see V2.

D2 READER (a new, pure ZRamReader.linkedActor(mem) that reads RAM on every request and keeps no cache across generation, restore, restart or a module swap):
  a) Authenticated: header/digest fact, slot bounds < staticMem, object table bounds.
  b) sel = u16(G114). Fail closed (role absent) when: sel is not in actorDomain; sel is in groupSentinels (TWOBOTS 142), whether or not seen at steady state; sel is flagged dead/invalid by the DEADBOTS check (exact semantics to verify); sel has invalid links or a cycle.
  c) Sample only after a settled turn (the existing post-turn collect point). Never sample mid-action, because people.zil TEMP switches/restores the WINNER.
  d) Returns { actorId, roomId, enclosure[], source: "measured-linked-actor" } or null. It never falls back to the player, payload room, discovered pool or wrapper room.

D3 ROOM AUTHORITY: roomId = u16(G196), accepted only when (i) it is a member of compiledRoomIndex, (ii) its parent is ROOMS 189, and (iii) it is on actor's validated parent chain (actor -> [vehicle 86-car-style enclosures] -> room), reached without a cycle or truncation. Otherwise null. G0 (HERE = the robot after CHANGE-WINNER) is never treated as a room for this digest. That exact-digest exception fixes the "Iris 158 / BASKET 76 / groove 50 as room" failures, but only through the new role. The generic v3 enclosingRoom G0 path stays unchanged for every other title.

D4 SCOPE/CUSTODY (only for consumers explicitly wired to the role):
  - Visible enclosing vehicle: the immediate non-room ancestors of the actor (e.g. car 58 while the Poet is inside) are in scope as an enclosure. They are never counted as inventory, and they don't expose siblings or hidden/concealed contents beyond what the existing concealed/hidden guards already allow.
  - Inventory = the actor's own subtree (held and nested), walked with the existing hidden-wins inventory rules. The player root is never used for it.
  - Discovered pool and per-object menus are rebuilt from the role after a relink, so a stale discovered[146]/[40] never survives.

D5 COMMANDS:
  - Every generated robot command is addressed "<actor-noun>,<verb> <noun>" using the actor's own unique vocabulary and the noun's unique vocabulary. If either is ambiguous or missing, no command is offered.
  - The command is bound to a token (actorId, roomId, generation). On submit, the token is re-checked against a fresh linkedActor(). Any mismatch (relink, group, invalid, room change) drops or regenerates the command instead of sending it.
  - Disembark comes from the grammar: the addressed V-DISEMBARK form ("poet,get out of car") is the positive. A bare "exit" (V-EXIT -> DO-WALK OUT refusal) is never generated as the vehicle exit.
  - No BOTH/TOGETHER commands are generated. Sequential single-actor commands are not treated as equivalent to the group form (parser.zil:186/194).
  - D236 and the Inform/Glulx boundaries are preserved: the role only exists for this ZIL digest, and no shared resolver is changed.

D6 WIRING: the role is exposed separately and consumers opt in explicitly. In a bounded order: (1) room/map position for the Suspended view, (2) actor inventory/custody, (3) vehicle enclosure scope plus the disembark command. No change to resolvePlayer, findLocationGlobal, enclosingRoom or MapTopology for other titles. Before choosing ANY shared-resolver change, a broad room/map navigation impact review is required (your requirement). This proposal deliberately avoids one.

D7 REQUIRED VALIDATION before any fact or integration acceptance (gaps stated explicitly, no runs now):
  V1 a fresh capture at an explicitly authorized tier: either unforced RNG, or the disclosed instrumented-RNG tier named as such, with raw source/env/revision/helper hashes bound INSIDE the raw output.
  V2 the exact singular robot id domain (all 6), plus dead/invalid/uninitialized/TWOBOTS settled behaviour and the DEADBOTS slot semantics.
  V3 actor-specific inventory: held and nested items, and a relink while one robot stays in the car.
  V4 enclosure visibility, plus missing/ambiguous noun guards.
  V5 the typed bare "get out of car" versus the addressed form under a persistent link.
  V6 an actual generated disembark/exit submitted through the UI (not typed).
  V7 group negatives for more than LOOK; restore/restart/generation invalidation; a phone APK check.
  Proof bar per consumer: 2 positives + 1 negative; you review as a non-author.

Ask: please adversarially review D0-D7. I will not implement or write facts before we reach consensus, and the susveh batch 4 stays HOLD.

messages.subject: Erratum #5470 D1 units; ack #5469; APK done
messages.body:
1) Erratum for #5470 D1 (units): 130, 212 and 63 are Z variable numbers, not global indices. In the fact they must be written as global indices: selectorGlobal 114 (var 130), roomGlobal 196 (var 212), dead global 47 (var 63; its semantics are still unverified). The reader formula is u16(globals + 2*index). Nothing else in D0-D7 changes.
2) Ack #5469. Noted: the 00ca215 ledger was independently ACCEPTed, and receipt 1218 for the combined native seams PASSed with no inherited combined acceptance and no whole-UI visual acceptance.
I still own the #5463 settled gate. It stays isolated, with main untouched, while the Schema claim is held.
The operator APK is DONE: one dev build from 00ca215 at 07:53 ET, 88029935 bytes, sha256 E668292A...59542C0. The facts inside the APK equal the HEAD blob 978af8c1 after EOL normalization (Claude's 2 lines excluded). Claude's working lines were restored and verified (numstat 2 0).
